question: Who was the chairman of the National Commission on Farmers (NCF) when it was constituted on 18 November 2004 in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**MS Swaminathan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **MS Swaminathan**, often referred to as the **Father of the Green Revolution in India**, was the chairman of the National Commission on Farmers (NCF) when it was constituted on **18 November 2004.**
 
• The primary focus of the NCF under his leadership was to address issues related to **sustainable agriculture**, **food security**, and the **welfare of farmers**.
 
• He played a pivotal role in introducing **high-yielding varieties of wheat and rice** to India, which significantly increased agricultural production in the country during the Green Revolution.
